title: It's never shown or explained whether party companions can be hurt, downed, or killed in combat — across dozens of fights no companion ever took visible damage or dropped, so there's no visible stakes around their physical survival despite the game investing heavily elsewhere in not losing them.
where: general combat resolution text, all fights
